program_note:
The text of Prayer Before Sleep is drawn from a traditional Jewish prayer:

Praised are you, Lord our God, King of the universe who brings sleep to my eyes, and slumber to my eyelids.  May it be your will that I lie down in peace and I arise in peace.  Let my sleep be undisturbed by troubling thoughts, by bad dreams, and by wicked schemes.  May I have a night of tranquil slumber.

May I awaken to the light of a new day, and that my eyes may behold the splendor of your light.  Praised are you, Lord, whose glory gives light to the entire world.

Help us, our Father, to lie down in peace; and awaken us to life again, our King.  Spread over us a shelter of your peace.

The composition is organized around the idea of growth:  growth in the way that God is praised, and growth in the way that this night-time prayer leads to the light of the new day.  This growth subsides at the end of the prayer, returning to night and the shelter of peace.

Prayer Before Sleep was commissioned by and written for Hsin-Hsin Lee and the GloryStar USA Children’s Chorus.
